description: This file implements a neon-optimized modulation mapper for various QAM schemes and QPSK, including functions for modulating symbols using neon instructions, with support for different modulation schemes and batch processing.

classes.name: modulation_mapper_neon_impl
classes.description: Class implementing neon-optimized modulation mapping functions for various schemes.

methods.name: modulate_qpsk
methods.description: Performs QPSK modulation on input symbols using neon instructions.

methods.name: modulate_qam16
methods.description: Performs 16-QAM modulation on input symbols using neon instructions.

methods.name: modulate_qam64
methods.description: Performs 64-QAM modulation on input symbols using neon instructions.

methods.name: modulate_qam256
methods.description: Performs 256-QAM modulation on input symbols using neon instructions.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Dispatches modulation based on the specified modulation scheme.
